text: Feel your heartbeat as the rhythm of the Universe. Place your hand on your chest and listen to your heart. And now feel that the Earth has the same pulse—the rhythm of day and night, seasons, tides and ebbs. The pulse manifests in accepting and letting go, in hunger and satiety, in birth and death... And even in the twinkling of a distant star. Feel yourself part of this grandiose multidimensional symphony.
